Comparative Financial Performance Analysis of Himbara Banks (FY2022–FY2024)

Interactive financial dashboard with an in-depth comparative analysis of four state-owned Himbara banks — BRI, Bank Mandiri, BNI, and BTN — sourced from official annual reports and OJK statistics.

Conclusion
  • Margin pressure is widespread; asset quality is polarized across Himbara banks.
